name: 微表情分析
description: 检测视频中不自然的微表情和面部动作单元模式。
useCase: Identifying 深度伪造s through abnormal facial muscle movement 模式
mechanism: 分析 Facial Action Coding System (FACS) action units 以检测 micro-expressions - brief, involuntary facial movements lasting 40-200ms. Deepfake videos often lack natural micro-expressions, show impossible AU combinations, or exhibit delayed/absent emotional transitions.
accuracy: Medium-高 - 76-88% on identity swap 深度伪造s
source: Agarwal, S. et al. (2020) - Detecting Deep-Fake Videos from Aural and Oral Dynamics, CVPR Workshop
algorithm: AU Detection (OpenFace) + Temporal Pattern Analysis + FACS Plausibility Verification
parameters: AU 检测: 17 core AUs, Temporal 分辨率: 40ms, Window: 200ms sliding, 阈值: AU probability > 0.5
strengths:
• 检测微妙表情的不自然
• 对情绪伪造的强力指标
• 高帧率下精度提升
• 心理学基础已确立
limitations:
• 低帧率下可能遗漏微表情
• 自然面无表情的人可能误检
• 文化差异影响表情模式
• 需要高质量正面影像

references.title: Agarwal, S. et al. (2020). Detecting Deep-Fake Videos from Aural and Oral Dynamics. CVPR Workshop.
Li, Y. & Lyu, S. (2019). Exposing DeepFake Videos By Detecting Face Warping Artifacts. CVPR Workshop.
Amerini, I. et al. (2019). Deepfake Video Detection through Optical Flow Based CNN. ICDP.
